notes.title: v0.42 Early Access UPDATE
notes.content:
* The Goatman's AI changed. When you entered the house or caravan, it will not wait for you outside. You know sometimes it keeps spinning where it is, I took a few measures to prevent it.
* Item selection&plant bug fixed
* Graveyard Event changed.
* Motion Blur added.
* Crows' positions changed.
* a few minor bugs fixed.

Note: We fixed critical bugs with this update.

notes.title: v0.41 Early Access UPDATE
notes.content:
- v0.41 Patch Notes
-------------------------------------------------------
* Goatman's AI changed.
* Goatman's health increased (Singleplayer)
* Flare Gun bug fixed.
* Sniper's damage increased
* Assault's damage increased
* Heavy's range reduced
* Animals attack range reduced.
* Graveyard added to compass
* You can carry 3 mines now.
* Ambient sound effect volume  increased
* Weather sound effect volume reduced(Rain - Storm etc...)
* Ending scene's fog density reduced.

tags.balance_change: * Weather sound effect volume reduced(Rain - Storm etc...)

notes.title: v0.3 Early Access UPDATE
notes.content:
- Goatman's AI changed
- Goatman & Animals nerfed
- Day&Night length much longer
- Caravan added to compass
- Chat system fixed
- Minor bugs fixed

We made these changes to make the game more balanced. You do not need to walk to see the monster for a long time. We also corrected minor bugs.

Note: We realy want to develop a legend monster hunting game with your support.  

Contact: https://discord.gg/GPkWbsB
